items.name: Iron Sword
items.description: A sturdy iron blade forged in the smithies of the Bloomguard outpost. Reliable, if unremarkable.

items.name: Wooden Club
items.description: A heavy club carved from dense hardwood found in the Everwood's outer groves. Has a chance to stun on impact.

items.name: Hunting Knife
items.description: A sharp, lightweight blade favored by scouts and hunters across Verdance. Quick to draw, quicker to cut.

items.name: Simple Bow
items.description: A basic shortbow made from flexible yew. Effective at medium range and easy to maintain in the field.

items.name: Light Crossbow
items.description: A mechanically simple crossbow popular among Verdance militia. Packs a solid punch at close to medium range.

items.name: Wooden Spear
items.description: A long-hafted spear with a sharpened ironwood tip. Standard issue for Verdance militia training.

items.name: Verdant Blade
items.description: A sword imbued with Verdance nature magic. Each swing trails faint green vines that linger in the air.

items.name: Thornwood Axe
items.description: An axe hewn from thornwood, its edge studded with natural barbs that tear deep and leave wounds weeping.

items.name: Shadow Dagger
items.description: A blade that drinks light, forged somewhere the Hollow Court does not speak of. Enhances stealth beyond natural limits.

items.name: Sap-Infused Bow
items.description: A bow soaked overnight in enchanted blue sap. Its arrows carry a faint magical charge that leaves glowing trails.

items.name: Bloomguard Mace
items.description: Standard-issue mace of the Bloomguard order. Its enchanted weighted head delivers punishing, bone-deep blows.

items.name: Wildkin Shortbow
items.description: Crafted by Wildkin scouts who know the breathing patterns of every beast in Verdance. Especially lethal against beasts and creatures.

items.name: Sporecaller Staff
items.description: A gnarled staff crowned with luminescent mushrooms that pulse with each spell cast. Amplifies spore-based and nature magic.

items.name: Emerald Edge
items.description: A crystalline blade that pulses with verdant energy drawn from deep forest ley lines. Each strike heals the wielder with stolen vitality.

items.name: Crimson Cleaver
items.description: Forged in volcanic vents beneath the Crimson Spire, this axe burns with perpetual flame that never consumes the blade.

items.name: Veilkeeper's Athame
items.description: A ritual blade carried by Veilkeeper acolytes during spiritual rites. It channels ambient DSP from the Veil's edge with each cut.

items.name: Ancient Longbow
items.description: A relic bow recovered from the old growth, still taut and true after centuries. Its arrows pierce through armor plating with ease.

items.name: Rootbinder Spear
items.description: Living roots spiral along its shaft, responding to the wielder's intent. On critical hits, root tendrils erupt from the wound to bind the target.

items.name: Thornlash Whip
items.description: A whip woven from living thornvines harvested at midnight. Each lash tears deep and leaves wounds that refuse to close.

items.name: Everbloom Sword
items.description: A radiant blade that blooms with golden light when it strikes true. Killing blows send healing pollen drifting to nearby allies.

specialAbility.name: Verdant Bloom
specialAbility.description: Regenerate 2 HP per second while in combat.

specialAbility2.name: Life Harvest
specialAbility2.description: Restore 8 HP to all nearby allies when an enemy is slain.

items.name: Scar's Edge
items.description: An axe forged from void-scarred metal recovered from the Architect's breach. Each wound it inflicts tears at the fabric of reality.

specialAbility.name: Void Rend
specialAbility.description: On hit, 15% chance to tear a void rift that deals 10 bonus void damage.

items.name: Nexus Staff
items.description: Channeling raw Nexus energy from the heart of Verdance, this staff amplifies all spellcasting to devastating effect.

specialAbility2.name: Phase Harmony
specialAbility2.description: Deal 25% bonus damage during the matching Sap phase.

items.name: Wildkin's Fang
items.description: Carved from the fang of an ancient wildkin alpha who guarded the Everwood for three centuries. Strengthens the bond with beast companions.

specialAbility.name: Beast Bond
specialAbility.description: Beast companions deal 20% more damage and have 15% more HP.

specialAbility2.name: Wildkin Swiftness
specialAbility2.description: Gain +15 movement speed after any kill.

items.name: Everwood's Heartwood
items.description: The living heart of the Everwood itself, granted only when all Veilkeepers survive and the forest's DSP flows at its peak. It radiates an aura of absolute purity that silences corruption.

requirements.special: All Veilkeepers must be alive and DSP must be 90+

specialAbility.name: Heart of the Forest
specialAbility.description: All allies regenerate 3 HP/sec and 2 Sap/sec while you wield this staff.

items.name: Void Architect's Blade
items.description: The weapon of the Void Architect themselves. Reality warps and fractures around its edge, and the screams of unmade things echo faintly from within. Drops only from the final confrontation.

specialAbility.name: Reality Fracture
specialAbility.description: Hits have a 20% chance to phase the target out of reality for 1 second, making them invulnerable but unable to act.

items.name: Leather Tunic
items.description: Simple tanned leather armor stitched together in the Verdance style. Offers modest protection without restricting movement.

items.name: Hide Armor
items.description: Armor fashioned from thick beast hide collected in the Everwood's outer ring. Decent protection at a small cost to agility.

items.name: Iron Chain
items.description: Interlocking iron rings provide strong protection but weigh heavily on the wearer. A common sight on Verdance militia.

items.name: Wooden Shield
items.description: A round shield of reinforced hardwood banded with iron. Provides additional blocking capability at minimal weight.

items.name: Bloomguard Scout Armor
items.description: Lightweight armor issued to Bloomguard scouts patrolling the Everwood perimeter. Reinforced panels of flexible thornweave absorb impact.

items.name: Thornbinder Leather
items.description: Dark leather armor woven with shadow-infused thornvine by Thornbinder craftsmen. Favored by those who move through darkness unseen.

items.name: Verdant Mail
items.description: Chain mail reinforced with living vines that tighten on impact. The forest itself seems to sustain its wearer.

items.name: Ironbark Plate
items.description: Plate armor carved from ironbark — a wood as hard as steel but significantly lighter. Favored by Bloomguard heavy infantry.

items.name: Moss Shield
items.description: A living shield carpeted in regenerative Everwood moss that slowly knits together wounds on its bearer.

items.name: Emerald Robes
items.description: Flowing robes woven with emerald thread harvested from the deepest Veilkeeper archives. They hum with concentrated spiritual power.

items.name: Shadowweave Armor
items.description: Armor spun from shadow silk by Hollow Court artisans. Its wearer flickers at the edge of visibility, never quite solid.

items.name: Crimson Plate
items.description: Plate forged in the Crimson Spire's deepest furnaces and quenched in volcanic brine. It radiates heat that naturally deflects incoming flame.

items.name: Rootguard Armor
items.description: Living roots form interlocking plates across this armor that tighten instinctively to deflect blows and resist binding magics.

items.name: Crystal Shield
items.description: A translucent shield grown from pure Nexus crystal in the Veilkeeper vaults. Its lattice structure reflects hostile spells back at attackers.

items.name: Veilkeeper's Vestments
items.description: Sacred garments of the Veilkeeper order, woven in the light of the Veil's peak. The spiritual boundary flows freely through their weave, reducing the cost of consultation.

specialAbility.name: Veil Resonance
specialAbility.description: Regenerate 2 DSP per turn while equipped.

specialAbility2.name: Veilsight
specialAbility2.description: Passively detect hidden enemies within 200 pixels.

items.name: Bloomguard Commander's Plate
items.description: The legendary armor of a Bloomguard Commander who held the Everwood gate for three days alone. Its enchanted plates slowly regenerate between clashes.

specialAbility2.name: Thornmail Plating
specialAbility2.description: Reflect 15% of melee damage back to the attacker.

items.name: Living Bark Armor
items.description: Armor grown from a still-living tree bound to its wearer through a Veilkeeper ritual. It breathes, heals, and fights alongside them.

specialAbility.name: Verdant Bloom
specialAbility.description: Regenerate 2 HP per second in all situations.

specialAbility2.name: Living Armor
specialAbility2.description: Defense slowly regenerates at 1 point per second up to maximum.

items.name: Shadow Mantle
items.description: A cloak of concentrated shadow stitched from the Hollow Court's deepest secrets. When the wearer delivers a killing blow, they vanish completely from sight.

specialAbility.name: Shadow Step
specialAbility.description: After each kill, vanish for 2 seconds and gain +20% move speed.

specialAbility2.name: Veilsight
specialAbility2.description: Detect hidden enemies within 150 pixels while this mantle is worn.

items.name: Everwood Aegis
items.description: The Everwood's ultimate shield — forged from heartwood, Nexus crystal, and pure DSP channeled at the forest's peak. Grants unparalleled protection and spiritual resilience.

specialAbility.name: Aegis of Verdance
specialAbility.description: Block up to 30 damage from any single hit. This shield recharges over 10 seconds.

items.name: Nexus Woven Cloak
items.description: Woven from threads of raw Nexus energy. The wearer exists partially across all phases simultaneously, doubling every phase-related bonus they hold.

specialAbility.name: Phase Walker
specialAbility.description: Phase bonuses are doubled. Gain access to all phase abilities simultaneously.

items.name: Minor Health Potion
items.description: A small vial of crimson liquid brewed from common verdant herbs. Restores a modest amount of health.

items.name: Health Potion
items.description: A standard healing potion brewed from concentrated verdant herbs. Reliably restorative in the field.

items.name: Greater Health Potion
items.description: A potent healing draught infused with concentrated life essence from the Everwood's inner grove.

items.name: Minor DSP Vial
items.description: A small vial of luminescent blue sap harvested at dawn. Restores a small amount of DSP energy.

items.name: DSP Essence
items.description: Concentrated spiritual energy crystallized and re-dissolved into liquid form. Restores moderate DSP energy.

items.name: Greater DSP Vial
items.description: A large vial of pure crystallized DSP energy. Floods the spirit with renewed connection to the Veil.

items.name: Antidote
items.description: A bitter tonic brewed from silver moss and thornwood bark. Neutralizes most common Verdance poisons on contact.

items.name: Guard Tonic
items.description: A thick, bitter brew that hardens skin and steels resolve. Temporarily boosts Guard against physical attacks.

items.name: Speed Elixir
items.description: A shimmering golden elixir that accelerates the drinker's neural reflexes to near-inhuman speed for a short time.

items.name: Invisibility Potion
items.description: Bends light around the drinker through a Hollow Court formula, rendering them invisible to ordinary sight for a brief time.

items.name: Viridian Bomb
items.description: A volatile sphere of compressed nature energy, unstable until the wax seal is broken. Explodes in a burst of emerald flame.

items.name: Spore Bomb
items.description: A fragile fungal pod packed with toxic spores cultivated in the Sporecaller's groves. Bursts on impact, poisoning everything nearby.

items.name: Flash Bomb
items.description: A thin glass sphere filled with compressed light energy. Detonates in a blinding flash that temporarily blinds all creatures in the area.

items.name: Frost Bomb
items.description: A crystal sphere filled with condensed cold drawn from the highest Verdance peaks. Shatters to freeze and slow all targets caught in the blast.

items.name: Corruption Grenade
items.description: A sealed iron container of concentrated corruption, confiscated from a Void Architect agent. Handle with extreme care — corruption spreads on contact.

items.name: Dreamroot Tea
items.description: A calming herbal brew steeped from dreamroot found near Verdance springs. Gently heals wounds and clears the mind of minor afflictions.

items.name: Everspring Tea
items.description: Brewed from rare herbs found only near the Everspring itself. Fortifies the spirit against all hazards and fortifies natural resistance.

items.name: Crimson Brew
items.description: A fiery concoction brewed at the edge of the Crimson Spire's heat vents. Stokes the drinker's aggression and significantly boosts damage output.

items.name: Silver Leaf Tea
items.description: A delicate infusion of rare silver leaf that grows on moonlit Everwood canopies. Sharpens the senses to a supernatural degree.

items.name: Blue Sap Tea
items.description: Sweet tea infused with dissolved blue sap crystals gathered at the Veilkeeper groves. Accelerates DSP recovery over several turns.

items.name: Trail Rations
items.description: Dried meat, roasted nuts, and hardtack pressed by Bloomguard quartermasters. Provides minor healing when consumed outside of combat.

items.name: Verdant Fruit
items.description: A luminous green fruit found only in the deepest Everwood groves where the light never reaches the ground. Slowly regenerates the eater's vitality.

items.name: Mushroom Stew
items.description: A hearty stew slow-cooked from enchanted forest mushrooms. Nourishes body, mind, and spirit alike with a single bowl.

items.name: Honey Cake
items.description: A rich cake glazed with golden forest honey harvested from the Bloomguard's sacred hives. Provides a sudden burst of manic energy.

items.name: Sacred Nectar
items.description: Nectar harvested from the sacred blossoms that bloom only during Verdance solstice. Fully restores the body and purges all afflictions in moments.

items.name: Scroll of Teleport
items.description: An ancient scroll inscribed with spatial runes by Nexus scholars. Reading it aloud instantly transports the user to a previously visited location.

items.name: Scroll of Identify
items.description: A divination scroll carrying a Veilkeeper's sight. Reading it reveals the true properties of one unidentified item.

items.name: Scroll of Protection
items.description: Reading this scroll aloud in a clear voice erects a shimmering barrier of hardened Sap energy around the reader.

items.name: Scroll of Revelation
items.description: Inscribed with the Veilkeeper's truth-seeing rune. Reveals hidden doors, traps, and invisible creatures in the surrounding area.

items.name: Scroll of Unbinding
items.description: A powerful scroll that severs corruption's grip from a person, object, or area. Considered priceless by the Bloomguard's cleansing corps.

items.name: Shadow Essence
items.description: A vial of pure, distilled shadow harvested from the Hollow Court's deepest chamber. Writhes and shifts even when sealed. Required for certain rituals.

items.name: Crimson Shard
items.description: A jagged fragment of crimson crystal that pulses with trapped inner heat. One of several shards that were part of something greater before it was shattered.

items.name: Veilkeeper Token
items.description: A carved wooden token bearing the Veilkeeper sigil, warm to the touch. Proof of the order's trust granted to true allies.

items.name: Hollowroot Key
items.description: A gnarled key grown from hollowroot over decades, shaped by the forest's will. Opens passages deep beneath the Everwood that no blade can cut through.

items.name: Corruption Sample
items.description: A sealed iron container of corrupted matter, carefully prepared by a Veilkeeper. Researchers at the Bloomguard outpost need this for their study.

items.name: Sacred Fire Fragment
items.description: An ember of the sacred fire, still burning after centuries without fuel. Essential for rekindling the ancient wards that protect Verdance's borders.

items.name: Ancient Map Fragment
items.description: A weathered piece of an ancient map drawn in ink that still glows faintly. Combine all fragments to reveal forgotten locations across Verdance.

items.name: Faction Sigil: Bloomguard
items.description: The official sigil of the Bloomguard faction, stamped in living bark and iron. Grants access to their strongholds and supply caches.

items.name: Faction Sigil: Veilkeepers
items.description: The sacred sigil of the Veilkeeper order, woven from moonlit thread. Marks the bearer as a recognized initiate of the spiritual covenant.

items.name: Faction Sigil: Wildkin
items.description: A bone-and-feather sigil carved from the antler of a forest elder. Accepted as a greeting among the Wildkin beast-speakers.

items.name: Faction Sigil: Thornbinders
items.description: A dark sigil woven from living thornvine that shifts and tightens when held. Grants passage among the Thornbinders and their shadow networks.

items.name: Faction Sigil: Crimson Spire
items.description: A heat-forged iron sigil that never cools entirely to room temperature. Opens the way to the Crimson Spire's volcanic domain and fire-forges.

items.name: Faction Sigil: Hollow Court
items.description: A sigil of shadow and whisper, pressed from nothing into something by Hollow Court artisans. The Court acknowledges the bearer as someone worth knowing.

items.name: Void Crystal
items.description: A crystal suffused with void energy that seems to absorb all light and sound in a two-meter radius. Central to understanding the Void Architect's plans for Verdance.

items.name: Sap Capacitor Totem
items.description: A carved totem that acts as a living battery for DSP, storing excess spiritual energy for release at will. Crafted by a Veilkeeper master.

items.name: Silver Moss Ring
items.description: A ring woven from silver moss and enchanted thread that subtly boosts resilience and slows poison effects on the wearer.

items.name: Emerald Amulet
items.description: An amulet set with a faceted emerald, amplifying nature spells and granting passive DSP regeneration to its wearer.

items.name: Void Pendant
items.description: A pendant that resonates with void energy, storing excess DSP and releasing it on command. Pulses faintly with a dark inner light.

items.name: Nexus Focus Ring
items.description: A ring carved from pure nexus shard, focusing magical energy to increase spell critical hit chance. Hums with concentrated power.

items.name: Living Root Band
items.description: A bracelet of intertwined living roots that actively draws in nature energy, boosting HP regeneration outside of combat.

items.name: Ironwood Log
items.description: A log of ironwood, a tree found only in the Everwood's heart where the earth is richest. Nearly as hard as iron but far lighter, prized by all crafters.

items.name: Emerald Dust
items.description: Fine powder ground from Everwood emeralds found along the Sap ley lines. Used to enchant equipment with nature magic and DSP attunement.

items.name: Shadow Silk
items.description: Silk spun by shadow-attuned spiders that nest in the Hollow Court's lower chambers. Light-absorbing and incredibly strong despite its gossamer weight.

items.name: Crimson Ore
items.description: Volcanic ore mined from deep within the Crimson Spire and infused with fire essence during formation. Glows with inner heat when struck with a hammer.

items.name: Silver Moss
items.description: A rare moss with a distinctive silvery sheen that grows on moonlit Everwood stones. Used extensively in alchemical preparations and enchantments.

items.name: Blue Sap Crystal
items.description: Crystallized blue sap, dense with spiritual energy harvested at the Veilkeeper groves. A key ingredient in all DSP-related crafting recipes.

items.name: Thornwood Bark
items.description: Bark stripped from thornwood trees at the forest's edge. Tough and fibrous with natural barbs, extremely useful for crafting sturdy defensive equipment.

items.name: Beast Hide
items.description: Thick, cured hide harvested from the large beasts that roam the Everwood's outer territories. A fundamental crafting material for medium armor.

items.name: Spore Extract
items.description: Concentrated extract drawn from toxic forest spores through a careful alchemical process. Dangerous to handle but extraordinarily useful in poisoncraft.

items.name: Void Fragment
items.description: A shard of void energy given momentary physical form, recovered from sites of Void Architect incursions. Warps light around itself. Used in high-tier crafting.

items.name: Ancient Resin
items.description: Petrified resin from trees that stood in Verdance before the first Sap cycle. Hardened over centuries into something stronger than most metals.

items.name: Crystal Shard
items.description: A small shard of Nexus crystal broken from a larger formation. Glimmers with a faint, constant luminescence and pulsing latent energy.

items.name: Living Root
items.description: A root from a Verdance tree that still pulses with life energy even after being carefully severed. Used in all nature-infused crafting and binding rituals.

items.name: Enchanted Thread
items.description: Thread spun from magically sensitized plant fibers treated with Sap essence. Essential for all magical tailoring, armor weaving, and scroll reinforcement.

items.name: Nexus Shard
items.description: A fragment of concentrated Nexus energy given crystalline form at the convergence point. Radiates significant power. Required for the most advanced crafting recipes.

items.name: Wolf Pelt
items.description: A thick, coarse pelt stripped from a forest wolf. Useful for crafting warm clothing and light armor padding.

items.name: Root Fiber
items.description: Tough, fibrous strands pulled from the roots of Everwood undergrowth. A versatile binding material for basic crafting.

items.name: Sprite Dust
items.description: Glittering residue left behind by forest sprites. Shimmers with faint magical energy and is prized by enchanters.

items.name: Beetle Shell
items.description: A hard, iridescent shell fragment from a giant forest beetle. Lightweight yet durable, suitable for reinforcing armor.

items.name: Spider Silk
items.description: Strong, elastic silk harvested from the webs of Everwood spiders. Valued for its tensile strength in bowstring and armor crafting.

items.name: Venom Sac
items.description: A bulbous sac of potent venom extracted from venomous forest creatures. Handle with care; useful in alchemy and poisoncraft.

items.name: Slime Residue
items.description: A viscous, gelatinous residue left behind by forest slimes. Surprisingly useful as an alchemical binding agent.

items.name: Spore Cap
items.description: The dried cap of a large forest mushroom, still dusted with potent spores. A staple ingredient in Sporecaller recipes.

items.name: Corrupted Bark
items.description: Dark, twisted bark peeled from a corruption-tainted tree. Pulses with unstable void energy and must be handled with gloves.

items.name: Dark Sap
items.description: Thick, blackened sap that seeps from corrupted trees. Radiates a faint aura of wrongness but holds potent alchemical properties.

items.name: Fungal Extract
items.description: A concentrated liquid drawn from deep-forest fungi through careful alchemical processing. Essential for nature-based potions.

items.name: Resonant Gem
items.description: A small crystalline gem that hums when held near sources of Sap energy. Resonates with the Veil and amplifies enchantments.

items.name: Serpent Scale
items.description: A tough, overlapping scale shed by the giant serpents of the Everwood river system. Excellent for reinforcing leather armor.

items.name: River Pearl
items.description: A lustrous pearl found in the freshwater mussels of Verdance rivers. Prized by jewelers and enchanters alike.

items.name: Wraith Vine
items.description: A ghostly, translucent vine that grows in areas where the Veil is thin. Phases in and out of visibility and is difficult to harvest.

items.name: Hollow Plate
items.description: A plate of hardened chitin taken from a Hollow Knight. Surprisingly light and strong, infused with residual shadow energy.

items.name: Knight Sigil
items.description: A small metal sigil torn from the armor of a fallen hollow knight. Carries faint echoes of duty and resolve.

items.name: Imp Horn
items.description: A small, curved horn snapped from a forest imp. Hard as bone and warm to the touch, used in minor alchemical recipes.

items.name: Abyssal Ember
items.description: A smoldering fragment of void-touched flame that never fully extinguishes. Radiates both heat and an unsettling chill.

items.name: Ancient Heartwood
items.description: Dense heartwood from one of the oldest trees in the Everwood. Rings with centuries of stored Sap energy when struck.

items.name: Elderroot Sap
items.description: Golden sap harvested from the ancient elderroot trees. Thick and aromatic, it possesses strong restorative properties.

items.name: Shadow Thread
items.description: Thread spun from condensed shadow essence by Hollow Court weavers. Nearly invisible in dim light and supernaturally strong.

items.name: Weaver's Eye
items.description: A crystallized eye harvested from a giant shadow weaver spider. Gleams with residual perception magic.

items.name: Bloodthorn Spike
items.description: A razor-sharp thorn from the bloodthorn brambles that grow near corruption sites. Stained permanently red from the blood of unwary travelers.

items.name: Beast Fang
items.description: A large, curved fang pulled from a predatory forest beast. Strong enough to be fashioned into crude weapons or jewelry.

items.name: Deeproot Core
items.description: The dense, energy-rich core extracted from the deepest taproots of ancient Everwood trees. Thrums with concentrated life force.

items.name: Petrified Bark
items.description: Bark from a tree that has turned entirely to stone over centuries. Incredibly hard and useful for crafting heavy armor and shields.

items.name: Sentinel Crystal
items.description: A crystal shard recovered from a fallen forest sentinel. Hums with a protective ward that lingers even after the sentinel has fallen.

items.name: Prismatic Shard
items.description: A brilliant shard that refracts light into a dazzling spectrum of colors. Radiates immense Nexus energy and is coveted by master enchanters.

items.name: Mycelium Crown
items.description: A crown-like fungal growth harvested from the Spore Lord. Pulses with the collective consciousness of the fungal network.

items.name: Sporelord's Staff
items.description: A gnarled staff recovered from the defeated Spore Lord. Still sprouts tiny mushrooms along its length and emanates spore clouds.

items.name: Fungal Heart
items.description: The pulsing core of a massive fungal entity, still beating with bioluminescent life. A powerful reagent for nature magic.

items.name: Hollow Crown
items.description: The shadowy crown of the Hollow King, wrought from solidified darkness. Whispers of forgotten oaths echo from within.

items.name: King's Greatsword
items.description: The massive greatsword of the Hollow King, too heavy for most mortals to wield. Its blade is forged from pure shadow steel.

items.name: Royal Sigil
items.description: A sigil of the old Hollow Court royalty, stamped in shadow-forged metal. Proof of dominion over the court and its secrets.

items.name: Abyssal Aegis
items.description: A shield fragment torn from the Abyssal Guardian, forged from void-hardened metal. Absorbs light and magic in equal measure.

items.name: Warden's Mantle
items.description: A tattered cloak worn by the ancient Forest Warden. Woven from living vines that still shift and grow even in death.

items.name: Nexus Heart
items.description: The crystallized heart of pure Nexus energy, pulsing with the lifeblood of Verdance itself. An artifact of unimaginable power.

items.name: Guardian Plate
items.description: A heavy plate of enchanted armor torn from a fallen grove guardian. Still hums with protective wards that never faded.

items.name: Thornback Pelt
items.description: A thick pelt covered in natural thorn-like protrusions, stripped from a thornback beast. Excellent for crafting spiked armor.

items.name: Bear Claw
items.description: A massive curved claw from an Everwood bear. Sharp enough to score ironwood and valued by weapon crafters.

items.name: Chitin Fragment
items.description: A piece of hardened chitin from a large forest insect. Light and tough, commonly used to reinforce leather armor.

items.name: Corrupted Heartwood
items.description: Heartwood twisted and darkened by void corruption. Pulses with a sickly purple light and is dangerously unstable.

items.name: Dryad Tear
items.description: A crystallized tear shed by a forest dryad. Glows with soft green light and holds deep nature magic within its facets.

items.name: Oakfather's Staff
items.description: A staff of ancient oak imbued with the essence of the Oakfather treant. Still sprouts leaves and channels nature magic.

items.name: Blighted Bark
items.description: Bark blackened and warped by a creeping blight. Crumbles at the edges but its core is surprisingly hard and saturated with dark energy.

items.name: Ancient Sap Crystal
items.description: A large crystal formed from sap that has been crystallizing for millennia. Contains an enormous reservoir of stored spiritual energy.

items.name: Crimson Heart
items.description: The molten core of a crimson fire elemental, still burning with eternal flame. Contained in a heat-resistant crystalline shell.

items.name: Abyssal Crown
items.description: A crown forged in the deepest void, taken from an abyssal lord. Warps reality around itself and whispers dark promises to those nearby.

items.name: Veil Dust
items.description: Fine, shimmering dust that collects where the Veil between worlds grows thin. Dissolves on contact with skin, leaving a tingling sensation.

items.name: Ember Ash
items.description: Fine ash left behind by extinguished fire elementals. Still warm to the touch and useful in fire-aspected alchemical recipes.

items.name: Moss Heart
items.description: The dense, spongy core of an animated moss creature. Saturated with moisture and regenerative energy from the forest floor.

items.name: Thorn Cluster
items.description: A dense cluster of razor-sharp thorns broken from a thornbeast. Can be fashioned into crude caltrops or woven into defensive gear.

items.name: Blight Gland
items.description: A pulsating gland extracted from a blighted creature. Oozes a toxic, corrosive substance that eats through leather but has alchemical uses.

items.name: Ancient Seed
items.description: A seed from one of the Everwood's oldest trees, dormant for centuries. Contains the potential for immense growth and powerful nature magic.

items.name: Warden Helm
items.description: The battered helm of a fallen grove warden, still etched with protective runes. A testament to the warden's unwavering vigilance.

items.name: Sap Crystal
items.description: A small crystal of solidified sap energy, naturally formed at Veil convergence points. A common but useful reagent for enchanting.

items.name: Bloomguard Insignia
items.description: An official insignia of the Bloomguard order, awarded for distinguished service. Its enchantment bolsters the wearer's resolve.

items.name: Beast Leather
items.description: Tanned leather crafted from the hides of Everwood beasts. Supple yet strong, suitable for a wide range of armor and equipment.

items.name: Bloomguard Captain's Cloak
items.description: A flowing green cloak worn by Bloomguard captains. Enchanted to deflect arrows and bolster leadership on the field.

items.name: Thornmaw Fang Necklace
items.description: A necklace strung with fangs from a slain Thornmaw beast. Grants the wearer a predator's aggression in combat.

items.name: Coven Blessing Amulet
items.description: An amulet blessed by the forest coven, pulsing with gentle healing magic. Slowly mends wounds over time.

items.name: Sporecaller Formula
items.description: A carefully transcribed alchemical formula used by the Sporecallers to brew their signature concoctions. The ink smells of mushrooms.

items.name: Expedition Map
items.description: A detailed map charting unexplored regions of the Everwood, annotated with warnings and points of interest by a seasoned scout.

items.name: Keeper Sealing Stone
items.description: A smooth, rune-carved stone used by Veilkeepers to seal breaches in the Veil. Warm to the touch and hums when near corruption.

items.name: Maren's Family Ring
items.description: A simple gold ring engraved with the name Maren. Carrying it brings a sense of warmth and determination to protect what matters.

items.name: Spirit-Blessed Vial
items.description: A vial of luminescent liquid blessed by forest spirits. Fully restores health and removes all negative effects when consumed.

items.name: Crystal Edge Blade
items.description: A blade forged with a crystalline edge that channels Nexus energy. Each strike leaves a faint trail of sparkling light.

items.name: Crystal Core
items.description: A dense core of pure crystallized energy extracted from a Nexus formation. Radiates a steady, soothing warmth.

items.name: Spore Lord Crown
items.description: A grotesque crown of living fungi torn from the Spore Lord. Grants dominion over spore magic and heightened awareness of the fungal network.

items.name: Mycelium Essence
items.description: A thick, luminescent extract drawn from the mycelium network beneath the Everwood. Pulses gently with fungal life energy.

items.name: Shadow Cloak
items.description: A cloak woven from shadow threads that shifts and blurs the wearer's outline. Grants enhanced stealth and evasion.

items.name: Skyfeather Charm
items.description: A charm crafted from the feather of a sky raptor, enchanted with wind magic. The wearer feels lighter on their feet.

items.name: Seer's Circlet
items.description: A delicate circlet worn by Veilkeeper seers during divination rituals. Enhances magical perception and spell potency.

items.name: Veilkeeper Focus
items.description: A crystalline focus ring used by Veilkeepers to channel spiritual energy. Enhances DSP regeneration and spell accuracy.

items.name: Wildkin Totem
items.description: A carved bone totem gifted by the Wildkin elders. Strengthens the bond with beast companions and enhances survival instincts.

items.name: Bloomguard Honour Medal
items.description: The highest honor bestowed by the Bloomguard. This enchanted medal inspires allies and strengthens the wearer's resolve in battle.

specialAbility.name: Bloomguard Honour
specialAbility.description: Nearby allies gain +2 to all attributes while in combat.

items.name: Worldroot Splinter
items.description: A splinter from the Worldroot, the mythical tree said to anchor Verdance to reality. Hums with a deep, resonant energy.

items.name: Mirror Realm Key
items.description: A crystalline key that reflects an impossible image in its facets. Opens the passage between the material world and the Mirror Realm.

items.name: Ritual Focus
items.description: A carved wooden focus used to channel energy during Veilkeeper rituals. Essential for performing the sealing ceremony.

items.name: Guardian Sigil
items.description: A sigil imbued with the essence of a grove guardian. Required to activate ancient protective wards throughout the Everwood.

items.name: Veilbound Amulet
items.description: An amulet bound to the Veil itself, allowing the wearer to sense disturbances in the spiritual boundary. Grants powerful magical protection.

specialAbility.name: Veil Attunement
specialAbility.description: Sense all hidden enemies within 100 pixels and gain +10% spell resistance.

items.name: Veil Shard
items.description: A fragment of crystallized Veil energy that shimmers between visibility and transparency. Needed to repair breaches in the spiritual boundary.

items.name: Veilguard Armor
items.description: Armor forged by the Veilguard order, infused with protective Veil energy. Shimmers between the physical and spiritual planes.

specialAbility.name: Veilguard Ward
specialAbility.description: Absorb the first 8 points of spell damage from each attack.

items.name: Nexus Crown
items.description: A crown fashioned from pure Nexus crystal that amplifies all magical abilities. The air around it crackles with raw energy.

specialAbility.name: Nexus Amplification
specialAbility.description: All spells deal 15% increased damage while wearing this crown.

items.name: Sap Charm
items.description: A small charm carved from crystallized blue sap. Enhances the wearer's connection to the Sap network and boosts energy recovery.

items.name: Sporecaller Focus
items.description: A ring grown from living fungal tissue by the Sporecallers. Enhances spore-based magic and grants resistance to toxins.
